description.narrative: The objectives of the Subnational Institutional Strengthening Project for Colombia are to: (i) improve Subnational Governments' (SNG) performance in core public management areas; and (ii) strengthen the capacity of the Borrower's central government to manage the decentralization and territorial management framework. The project has five components: the first component is structuring regional and local projects and designing long-term territorial strategic planning tools. This component will: (i) provide support to national planning ministry (DNP) to strengthen the Borrower's capacity; (ii) provide support to DNP to improve its access to information relevant for regional planning decisions; and (iii) provide support to DNP and SNGs to identify potential sources of regional development financing. The second component is applying incentives for territorial management. This component will support the following activities: (i) assess SNGs' public management capacity development; (ii) establish good practice standards in several areas of subnational public management (including tax administration, strategic planning, public financial management, administrative control, financial reporting, and procurement); and (iii) design and implement an incentive framework to reward SNGs' management performance. The third component is providing technical assistance support to SNGs. This component will: (i) strengthen SNGs' management capacity; (ii) design and implement the Territorial Management Model (TMM); (iii) strengthen DNP's and Ministry of Finance (Ministerio de Hacienda y Credito Publico) (MHCP's) technical, operational, and managerial capacity to ensure full implementation and adequate maintenance of the TMM; and (iv) improve citizen participation and social control in the public management cycle's processes. The fourth component is strengthening control and monitoring of territorial management. It will help in the following activities: (i) strengthen DNP and MHCP's administrative control over budget spending; and (ii) strengthen DNP and MHCP's public management capacity. The fifth component is project management and administration to provide support to DNP and Territorial Development and Fiduciary Agency (Financiera del Desarrollo Territorial Sociedad Anónima (FINDETER) for the carrying out of project coordination and management activities, including: administrative, financial management, procurement, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, auditing, and other operational activities required for effective project implementation.

The objectives of the project are to: (i) improve SNGs performance in core public management areas; and (ii) strengthen the Borrower's central government's capacity to manage the Decentralization and Territorial Management Framework.

title.narrative: Level of automation of administrative and financial processes

target.value: At least 210 beneficiary subnational governments have increased their automation level by 10 points based on the Digital Government Index - MIPG Indicator I20.

comment.narrative: This indicators has been achieved. Currently 263 beneficiary municipal governments have increased their digital government score by 10 points reflecting an improvement in processes automatization.

actual.value: 263 beneficiary subnational governments have increased their automation level by 10 points based on the Digital Government Index - MIPG Indicator I20.

title.narrative: Intermediate Result indicator 3.1: Territorial Management Model (TMM) design.

baseline.value: No design of the Territorial Management Model is place

target.value: Design of the Territorial Management Model (TMM) has been completed, including the definition of technical specifications and implementation strategy.

comment.narrative: This indicator has been achieved. NPD has developed an implementation strategy for the TMM and completed the detailed technical specifications for the financial and revenue management module.

actual.value: Design of the Territorial Management Model (TMM) has been completed, including the definition of technical specifications and implementation strategy.

title.narrative: Intermediate Result indicator 4.2: Design of instruments for territorial management control.

comment.narrative: This indicator has been achieved. Functional requirements for the control model have been integrated in the design of TMM modules.

actual.value: Control model integrated in the TMM

title.narrative: Intermediate Result indicator 3.3: Provision of Technical Assistance to Subnational Governments

baseline.value: No technical assistance on the functionalities of the TMM has yet been provided.

target.value: 300 municipalities have received technical assistance as part of the TMM.

comment.narrative: This indicator has been achieved. The NPD has provided technical assistance to 365 subnational governments in the modules of the TMM through a team of territorial advisors. The technical assistance was focused on planning, monitoring and evaluation of territoral development plans, budgeting, financial management and public investment management.

actual.value: 365 municipalities have received technical assistance as part of the TMM.

title.narrative: Intermediate Result indicator 3.4: Technical assistance to strengthen citizen participation along the public management cycle.

baseline.value: No tools or methodologies exist to support citizen participation.

target.value: A citizen participation toolkit has been designed and implemented by at least 50 municipal governments.

comment.narrative: This indicator has been achieved. The KPT citizen participation toolkit has been used by 565 subnational goverments for the planning of public investment projects financed through the General Royalties System (SGR) transfers.

actual.value: The territorial platform (KPT) provides a toolkit for citizen participation in the planning process of public investment projects.The toolkit has been used by 565 subnational governments.

title.narrative: Intermediate Result indicator 3.2: Implementation of the Territorial Management Model (TMM)

baseline.value: TMM has noy yet been implemented

target.value: TMM has been implemented in at least 280 municipal governments.

comment.narrative: The TMM has been fully implemented in 40 municipal governments. The TMM is comprised by 3 modules: Planning (Module 1), financial and revenue management (Module 2), and monitoring and evaluation (Module 3). Modules 1 and 3 have been implemented in all 280 target beneficiary municipal governments, and module 2 in 40.  It is not expected that module 2 will be implemented in additional municipal governments by the project current closing date.

actual.value: The TMM has been fully implemented in 40 municipalities.

title.narrative: Intermediate Result indicator 1.1: Formulation of modern spatially integrated territorial development plans (POT)

comment.narrative: By the end of the project a total of 9 PODs, 36 POTs and 1 territorial land use plan for a metropolitan area were completed and formulated.

title.narrative: Intermediate Result indicator 1.2: Implementation of multi-purpose land cadaster pilot

baseline.value: The multi-purpose land cadaster has not been piloted in any municipality.

target.value: Pilots have been implemented in 7 municipalities

comment.narrative: This indicator has been achieved. All products from the multipurpose cadaster pilots have been delivered to the final beneficiaries and the cartography has been validated by IGAC.

actual.value: Pilots have been implemented in 7 municipalities

title.narrative: Indicator 1.3: Development and implementation of a support platform to formulate Territorial Land Use Plans

baseline.value: Beta version of the platform has been completed but has not yet been officially launched

target.value: At least 60 subnational governments have used the platform to formulate Land Use Plans.

comment.narrative: This indicator has been achieved and surpassed.

actual.value: The platform to formulate Land Use Plans is used by 384 subnational governments.

title.narrative: Percentage of beneficiary Subnational entities using instruments developed by the project to strengthen the decentralization framework and public management

comment.narrative: This indicator has been achieved. The National Planning Department has developed SisPT as an improved version of  the Territorial Portal (KPT). Currently, 782 subnational entities are using the tools developed by SisPT, including all beneficiary municipal governments where modules 1 and 3 of the Territorial Management Model have been implemented.

title.narrative: Percentage of beneficiary municipalities with updated long term planning instruments

comment.narrative: This indicator has been partially achieved. This indicator is unchanged. No additional POTs will be financed and formulated by the project. Overall  27 (8 in zone 4 and 19 n zone 2) out of 39 planned POTs have been formulated.

title.narrative: Percentage of beneficiary municipalities with an improved management score in the Municipal Performance Measure (MDM) index

target.value: 50% of beneficiary municipalities have improved their score in the management component of the MDM index by at least 10 points

comment.narrative: This indicator has been achieved and the target surpassed by 7%. 160 out of 150 beneficiary municipal governments improved their score by at least 10 points in the MDM management score. The MDM management score is measured as the average in the scores of budget execution and open government.

title.narrative: Intermediate Result indicator 1.4: Formulation of Regional Land Use Plans (MOTR) and Regional Strategic Plans (PER)

baseline.value: No MOTR and PER have yet been formulated.

target.value: MOTR and PER have been formulated for at least 4 regions.

comment.narrative: This indicator has been partially achieved. The DNP has provided clearance to 5 strategic regional plans (PER) for territorial regional associations (RAP). These include the following regions: Pacifico, Eje Cafetero, Region Central, Amazonia, and del Agua y la Montaña. As for the development of MORTs the government has taken the decision to scale back and reassess its approach.

actual.value: PER have been formulated and approved for 5 regions.
